text: I'm okay. Really. I'm just... trying to figure out what I'm for.
She doesn't talk to me much. I don't blame her. I wouldn't talk to me either.
I still reach for my wedding ring sometimes. Then I remember whose ring it is.
I'll keep an eye out for supplies. It's the least I can do.
Nice weather. For the end of the world, I mean.
I'm not going anywhere. Just so you know.
She's trying. I'll give her that. Doesn't mean I have to like it.
Every time she laughs, I hear myself. It's like hearing your voice on a tape recorder.
Coffee? Well. Something brown and hot, anyway.
...Thanks.
You hold your rifle the same way I do.
You hold it the same way I do.
...Right.
Do you want me to take watch tonight?
I'll take it.
Found these. I think they fit your gun?
Here. Stimpaks. You get hurt more than you let on.
Some caps. Don't ask where I found them. Actually, it was a mailbox. That's... legal, right?
Screws, and some good adhesive. I know you like building things.
I don't know what this is, but it looked important.
Can I ask you something? Am I... doing well? With all of this? I just want to be useful to you.
Oh. Okay. Actions, not things. I can do that. I want to do that.
Really? Okay! I'll keep looking.
You... thank you. That means more than you know. I'll find you the good stuff. The really good stuff.
...Right. Of course. I'll stick with it.
That was a good thing you just did, hon.
That was cold, Nate. Even for her.
Found some more for you. Still keeping an eye out!
Rare junk, as promised. Gears, and a little bit of circuitry.
Look at this. Nuclear material! Don't worry, I didn't lick it.
Here. It's what I'm good for.
More supplies. I'll get more tomorrow.
Hon, got a minute? It's about her.
She's not as bad as I thought. I hate saying it, but I'm starting to enjoy having her around.
What you told her about actions, not things? It gave her some confidence. You can see it in how she carries herself.
She's useful, I'll give her that. But I think there's more to her than collecting junk.
You were honest with her, and she lit up like a Christmas tree. I've started helping her look. Don't tell her I said this, but it's kind of fun.
You were a little rough on her. I get it, believe me. I'm not exactly comfortable either.
Fair enough. I just think she's got more in her than either of us expected. Room to grow.
She found the gears. I found the screws. Don't let her tell you otherwise.
Left flank. You take it.
On it.
You were right. It was green. The dress.
I know. ...It looked better on me.
You can take watch tonight. Wake me at two.
I will. Thank you.
She covered me back there. I didn't ask her to.
She let me take watch last night. I know that sounds small. It isn't.
Hey, honey. Can I talk to you about... her?
Oh. Okay. Just get back to me soon, okay?
We've been traveling together for a while now, the three of us. And she seems... okay. She hasn't hated my company, anyway. I want to know what you think.
Hmm. My thoughts as well.
I agree. I'm still a little uneasy with her, but I do like her.
My thoughts exactly. I'll keep an eye on her.
I don't trust her. But I also don't think she's a machine. She's something more.
...I heard that. Thank you.
Arm's length. Okay. I can work with arm's length.
That was a great shot.
You're not so bad yourself.
Your hair looks good like that.
It's your hair.
Then it looks great.
You're good at this. Talking to people. Getting them to listen.
Three years of law school. You'd know.
Hold still! Stimpak!
I've got you. I've got you.
Here. Don't you dare die on me.
Up. Come on, up.
Thanks.
...Thanks. I owe you one.
Hello! Can I talk to you?
Oh. Okay. Just get back to me soon, okay?
Oh. I... s-sorry. I'll be quick.
Hey. I know you... uh. Don't... think that highly of me. But I just want to say thank you. For taking me along with you.
You're... you're still the person I married all those years ago. I love you. But... do you still... even want to be around me?
You... mean that? Okay. Okay. We can work through it. Together.
I don't... I don't know what to say. Thank you. I'm going to remember this. I'm good at remembering.
A poor copy. Right. I'll... I'll keep her alive, then.
Nate. That's enough.
Thanks! Look, I know it was weird seeing... me. Yeah. Me, twice. And now that I understand this world a little better, I know how big a chance you took on me.
I don't want that to go unsaid. I still see you as my husband. I don't really know what to think of... the other me. But I've enjoyed her company for a while now, and I want to thank you both.
Th-thanks. Look, I... I know it was weird seeing... me. Yeah. Me, twice. And now that I, um, understand this world a little better, I know how big a chance you took on me.
I don't want that to go... unsaid. I still see you as my husband. I d-don't really know what to think of the other me. But I've enjoyed her company for a while, and I want to... to thank you both.
You trust me. Okay. Good. That's... good.
My own special person. I like the sound of that. I think I'll keep it.
Oh. I thought... never mind what I thought.
Where the hell did that come from?
Then say it. Whatever you're going to do with me, say it. I'd rather know.
...You scared me. Don't do that again.
You heard him. Let's go.
I'll go back to the vault. It's the only place I know to wait.
Was that what you wanted? Was it?
Okay. I'll go. Take care of her. She's the real thing.
Nate... no. Not like this.
I can't keep doing this. Every time I think I've found a place with you, you remind me what I am.
I'm going. Don't follow me. Please.
Nate. Go after her. ...Nate!
